reason: A DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that adds four Solarized and Selenized palettes to the settings theme picker, including code-block syntax colors.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加四种 Solarized 和 Selenized 配色主题，并在设置中提供主题选择。
summaries.en: Adds four Solarized and Selenized color themes to DeepSeek Harness with selectable options in Settings.

capabilities: Registers four Solarized and Selenized visual themes
Adds selectable theme options to the DeepSeek Harness settings interface
Stores the selected theme per browser in localStorage
